mapper.select:
WITH TEMP2 AS (SELECT CONTRACTNO,sum(CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(price, '^-?\d+(.\d+)?$') THEN TO_NUMBER(price) ELSE 0 END) AS PROJALLPRICE FROM (SELECT a.projectprice AS price,a.contractno FROM t_emc_project a UNION ALL SELECT c.testfee AS price,c.contractno FROM T_XFP_PROJECT@LIMS_CZJKY_XFP c) AP WHERE contractno IS NOT null GROUP BY AP.contractno )
SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, TEMP2.PROJALLPRICE FROM T_CRM_CONTRACT@LIMS_CZJKY_HT A LEFT JOIN TEMP2 ON A.CONTRACTNO = TEMP2.CONTRACTNO where a.contractorgname =( SELECT A1.SSGFGSMC FROM T_EMC_OA_ORG A1 LEFT JOIN T_EMC_OA_USER A2 ON A1.ZZBH=A2.SSBM LEFT JOIN T_CORE_USER A3 ON A2.YGGH =A3.ID WHERE A3.ID=#{loginUser.id})) T
ORDER BY
T.ID DESC
